content: Next focus in bonbon-land is writing. We have a good start on reading with the demo site and the full app for Mac and Linux desktops. Initially writing is going to come from at least two places: 1. WordPress and 2. RSS.chat. But most important are the myriad possible ways people like to write. This is where having open formats and protocols will really pay off. Writing tools can depend on interop, they won't have to blaze their own trail so much. People creating brilliant writing tools like to focus on that, not a dozen different incompatible APIs and limits. How the hell do you get writing to fit into 500 chars on one network, 300 on another, 280 on yet another. And character limits are just the beginning.
